Nigerian Army Regular Recruitment Intake (RRI) Application Details

The Nigerian Army is officially accepting applications for the 91 Regular Recruit Intake (90RRI) for both Tradesmen/Women and Non-Tradesmen/Women.

This is your unique opportunity to defend Nigeria’s territorial integrity, contribute to national security, and access comprehensive military training that will set you up for a great career.

Application is 100% FREE! Do not pay anyone to apply.

About the Recruitment

The Nigerian Army 90RRI is the process for enlisting candidates as Non-Commissioned Officers (NCOs) or soldiers.

Successful candidates will undergo rigorous training at the Depot Nigerian Army before being posted for service.

Nigeria Army Regular Recruitment Benefits

If selected into the Nigerian Army, you will enjoy the following benefits;

  • Monthly Salary

  • Hands-on Training

  • Employment and Career Opportunity

Nigerian Army Regular Recruitment Intake (RRI) Application Requirements

To be eligible for the Nigerian Army Regular Recruitment Intake (RRI) Application, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

General Eligibility

  • Citizenship: Must be a Nigerian citizen by birth.

  • Marital Status: Must be single.

  • Fitness: Must be medically, physically, and psychologically fit according to Nigerian Army standards.

  • Criminal Record: Must be free of any criminal conviction by a court of law.

  • Identification: Must possess a valid National Identity Card/NIN slip and a BVN printout.

2. Age and Height Requirements

CategoryAge Limit (As of 30th December 2026)Height RequirementNon-Tradesmen/WomenNot less than 18 years and not more than 22 years.Male: Not less than 1.68 metres (5.5 ft) tall.Tradesmen/WomenNot less than 18 years and not more than 26 years.Female: Not less than 1.65 metres (5.4 ft) tall.

3. Educational Qualifications

  • All applicants must possess at least a minimum of four passes including English Language in not more than two sittings in WASSCE/GCE/NECO/NABTEB.

  • Tradesmen/Women must also possess an additional Trade Test/City and Guild Certificate in their respective trades.

Required Documents for Nigerian Army 91RRI Screening

Candidates who are shortlisted must report to their respective state screening centres with the following documents and materials. Note that you must tender all original copies of your certificates for verification.

 

A. Application and Identity Documents

 

  1. Printed Online Application Form: A printed copy of the completed online application form.

  2. Duly Completed Guarantor’s Form: The printed Guarantor Form must be completed and properly signed by the required individuals (Local Government Chairman/Secretary or Military Officer of the rank of Lieutenant Colonel and equivalent and above).

  3. National Identification Slip (NIN): A printed copy of your National Identity Card/NIN slip.

  4. Bank Verification Number (BVN) Printout.

  5. Certificate of State of Origin: A valid certificate issued by the relevant Local Government Council/State Government.

  6. Birth Certificate/Declaration of Age: Must be a valid certificate endorsed by the National Population Commission, Hospital, or Local Government Council.

  7. Passport Photographs: Two recent passport-sized photographs.

 

B. Educational and Professional Certificates

 

  1. Primary School Documents:

    • Original Primary School Testimonial.

    • Original Primary School Certificate.

  2. Secondary School Documents:

    • Original Secondary School Testimonial.

    • Original Statement of Results for WAEC/NECO/GCE or equivalent (or original certificate, if available).

    • Note: Applicants must possess at least a minimum of four passes including English Language in not more than two sittings.

  3. For Tradesmen/Women Only:

    • Original Trade Test/City and Guild Certificate in your relevant field.

 

C. Screening Essentials

 

  • Writing Materials: Pen, notebook, etc.

  • Sports Wear: You should bring blue shorts, a white vest, and canvas footwear for physical screening.
